title: Simultaneous determination of an unknown bending moment and shear force in the Euler Bernoulli cantilever beam from measured boundary defection and slope
summary: It is known that the study of vibration characteristics at the tip of the micro-cantilever and its relationship to the sample plays a very important role in improving the resolution of an Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM). In this paper, within the Euler Bernoulli beam model, a mathematical model, defined as a model with two unknown inputs and two measured outputs, is considered for the simultaneous determination of the unknown bending moment and the shear force at the tip of the micro-cantilever from two feasible measured outputs at the same tip: the deflection and the slope.
